notes.title: Update Notes for June 12
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Replaced the snowman puzzle altogether with a similar but different twist. This new variant makes the puzzle easier to understand.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch notes for February 26
notes.content:
[list]
[*] A few days ago an update was released where it's now possible to replay any unlocked levels. For some people this may have caused that entering the seagull puzzle or gradient puzzle (the ones where small puzzle pieces turn into bigger ones), the game thought these levels were triggered to be replayed even if the user didn't select that. This is now fixed so it doesn't happen again. 

As a note, if these levels have previously been completed, nothing is changed in what's unlocked in level select and general savefile progress, it's just an optional replay of previous levels.
[/list]

notes.title: Update notes for February 21
notes.content:
[list]
[*]  Added a way to replay any unlocked levels. (This also means for the very first people who got the game before the snowman patch, it's now possible to reset this level)
[*] Fixed a bug where in rare cases completing a puzzle would not trigger the level complete animation and return to level select
[/list]
